senses.gloss: धुस्तुर m. (-रः) Thorn apple, (Dhatura fastuosa:) see the next.

धुस्तूर m. (-रः) Thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa:)
 E. धूष् to make hand-
some, affix क्विप्, तूर् to be mischievous, affix क; elegant but deleteri-
ous: the vowels are also both made short, as धुस्तुर, or both remain
long, as in धूस्तूर also written धुत्तूर ।

धूस्तूर m. (-रः) The thorn apple, (Dhutura metel and fastuosa.)
 E. धूस्
elegant, and तूर injurious: see धुस्तुर.

धूश r. 10th cl. (धूशयति-ते) To make splendid or elegant; also धूष, and
धूस । चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

धूष r. 10th cl. (धूषयति-ते) to make splendid or elegant चुरा० उभ० सक०
सेट् । also धूश and धूस ।
धूस r. 10th cl. (धूसयति-ते) To embellish, to make splendid or elegant.

धूसर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Grey, of that colour.
 m. (-रः)
 1. Grey, (the colour,)
2. A jack ass.
 3. An oilman.
 4. A camel.
 5. A pigeon.
 6. Any
thing of a grey tint.
 f. (-री) A female Kinnara or chorister of
heaven.
 E. धृ to agitate (the mind,) सर Uṇādi aff.

धूसरछदा f. (-दा) A plant commonly Swetarāsna.
 E. धूसर grey, and छद
a leaf, grey-leaved.
